answer: To mint valid agent identities, participants must execute cryptographic stake burning scaled superlinearly as O(N^2) relative to total registered nodes. In this network topology, an adversary attempting a Sybil attack cannot simply grow a sprawling vine of cheap replicas; burning unrecoverable tokens creates severe economic friction. Much like casting valuable sable pelts into a deep lagoon, the exponentially escalating capital burn renders mass identity spoofing mathematically unviable.
